node.title: L1 fixed-source quotient-partition anchor census
node.statement: Fix one maximal sunflower source with M_src petals of size ell. A monic degree-ell quotient polynomial carrying one whole source petal T_i satisfies P-a_i=L_(T_i), so two such polynomials anchored by the same petal differ only by a constant and induce the same level-fiber partition. Least-petal ownership gives at most M_src anchored partition classes. Each has at most n/ell complete fibers and hence at most 3^(n/ell) core/petal/unused structural keys. At ell>=c_0 n/log_2 n the aggregate M_src 3^(n/ell) is polynomial. The anchor hypothesis is not automatic: dense support does not make a whole petal one quotient fiber. This census alone does not count label-sensitive coefficients; the downstream anchored triple-polarity closure pays all numerator/Forney multiplicity at fixed layout, defect, and petal polarity. Smaller-fiber refinements, growing polarity, arbitrary locators, and general anchor supply remain open.
